note: Importable GitHub issues for Sewlio Studio. Epics (umbrella) + Wave-1 tasks (S1-S13, milestones M1-M6). Later epics carry umbrella issues only; their tasks are added per rolling wave. See docs/09-project-management. 'dependencies' list parent task/feature IDs (encoded in title prefixes).

epics.title: E1 Foundation (kernel + runtime)
epics.body: Command bus, event bus, ids/time, diagnostics, service registry. The only mutation path. Features E1-F1..F5. Depends: none.

epics.title: E2 IR Framework
epics.body: Versioned/serializable/immutable IR traits + golden harness. Features E2-F1..F3. Depends: E1.

epics.title: E3 Geometry Engine (Geometry IR)
epics.body: Points, paths, curves, transforms, bbox, algorithms; mm-internal, deterministic. Features E3-F1..F7. Depends: E2.

epics.title: E4 Document Model & Project
epics.body: Project/layers/objects; command-driven mutation; events; undo. Features E4-F1..F4. Depends: E3.

epics.title: E5 Storage & Recovery
epics.body: .embproj, atomic save, migration, recovery. Features E5-F1..F4. Depends: E4.

epics.title: E6 Import Pipeline (Import IR)
epics.body: Import IR; SVG/raster/emb parsers; normalization. Features E6-F1..F4. Depends: E3, E5.

epics.title: E7 Embroidery Engine (Stitch IR)
epics.body: Stitch IR; running/satin/fill/underlay; density, compensation, sequencing, optimization. Features E7-F1..F9. Depends: E3.

epics.title: E8 Machine Compiler (Machine IR)
epics.body: Machine IR; needle/thread mapping; machine/hoop validation. Features E8-F1..F3. Depends: E7.

epics.title: E9 Export / Generators
epics.body: DST first, then EXP/PES/JEF/VP3/HUS. Consume Machine IR only. Features E9-F1..F3. Depends: E8.

epics.title: E10 Simulation (Playback IR)
epics.body: Playback IR; timeline, needle motion, stats. Depends: E7.

epics.title: E11 Rendering
epics.body: Scene/render graph, GPU backend, viewport, LOD. Depends: E3, E10.

epics.title: E12 Desktop UI
epics.body: Shell, canvas, tools, panels, inspector, import/export UI. Depends: E4, E11, E15.

epics.title: E13 AI Runtime
epics.body: Knowledge graph, rule engine, AI digitizer, quality inspector, assistant. Command-only, explainable, human-approved. Depends: E7, E8.

epics.title: E14 Plugin System
epics.body: Plugin runtime, sandbox, extension registry. Depends: stable public APIs (post-E9).

epics.title: E15 FFI Bridge (frb + WASM)
epics.body: Command dispatch, event stream, progress; WASM path. Depends: E1.

epics.title: E16 Testing, CI/CD & Security
epics.body: Golden/perf/compat/fault harness, pipelines, dependency-direction enforcement, permissions/audit. Cross-cutting, continuous. Depends: E1.
